expectation_basis: All 11 variant records / 18 language files. Block/undef entry storage has no controlled scalar initial value: tests vary six valid selected int regions in a six-element CN stack array, corresponding to abstract non-null aligned QCP addresses. No-op tests begin with genuinely uninitialized CN storage and require an initialized owned zero on exit; physical coincidental zero bits do not establish initialization. Identity specification separately supplies old including the zero masking case. Empty-footprint write expected ERROR is guarded by the exact writable-permission diagnostic independently read from the executor binary before testing. Original 3.c weak existential post retained.
